title: Computers
subtitle: Every computer on the server, and the tool that places new ones

overview.rule_boot: Boot sequence when a computer opens
overview.rule_reach: A computer closes itself %s m away

computers.pick_title: Make an existing prop a computer
computers.pick_hint: Aim at any monitor or laptop the game already has in the world and press Enter. Nothing is spawned: the prop standing there becomes this computer.
computers.picked_hint: A prop the game already has in the world, so it cannot be swapped or moved. Delete this computer to give the prop back.
computers.style_default_hint: No style of its own: it opens in the server's default, currently %s.
computers.name: Name
computers.jobs_empty: No jobs listed: anyone who walks up to it can sign in.
computers.jobs_hint: A job name as your framework spells it, and the lowest grade allowed. The server checks it on every action.
computers.boss_typing: No job is called %s. Keep typing, or pick one from the list.
computers.boss_unknown: This server has no job called %s yet. Nobody gets the Business Manager here until it does.
computers.boss_no_rank_hint: %s has no boss rank, so nobody would get the Business Manager here. Mark one of its grades as boss in your framework first.
computers.boss_off_hint: Nobody manages a job from this computer.
computers.boss_any_hint: Any boss who signs in here gets the Business Manager for their own job: staff, ranks, hiring and funds. Everyone else sees the usual apps.
computers.boss_any_locked_hint: A boss of a job listed under Access gets the Business Manager for their own job here: staff, ranks, hiring and funds. Everyone else sees the usual apps.
computers.boss_job_hint: The %s boss gets the Business Manager here: staff, ranks, hiring and funds. Everyone else sees the usual apps.
computers.boss_job_none: Choose the job whose boss manages from this computer.
computers.boss_locked_out: %s is not listed under Access, so its boss cannot open this computer.
computers.boss_unavailable_disabled: The Business Manager is switched off for the whole server (Enabled in configs/shared/boss.lua).
computers.boss_unavailable_framework: The Business Manager needs QBCore or Qbox, so it is not available on this server.
computers.manages_any: Business Manager for any boss, each for their own job
computers.aim_hint: Next you place it with the gizmo: it starts sitting on whatever you are looking at, so aim at the desk first.
computers.search: Search by name, id, prop, style or job
computers.none_placed: Nothing placed from the panel yet.
computers.script_hint: Added by %s with the AddComputer export: change it there
computers.delete_placed_body: All %s computers placed or picked from this panel go, and anyone using one is signed out. The computers in the config stay.
computers.remove_confirm: "%s" is taken away, and anyone using it is signed out. Its logs are kept until they expire.
computers.remove_config_confirm: "%s" stops being a computer, and anyone using it is signed out. It comes from the config, so it stays in this list and you can restore it at any time.
computers.removed_hint: Removed in this panel: nobody can use it until it is restored

auto.title: Automatic computers
auto.master: Props in the world are computers
auto.master_hint: Switch this on and the monitors and laptops the game already has work as a computer wherever one stands, without being placed. While it is off, a computer is one you placed or picked.
auto.spare_hint: Not listed for this computer in configs/shared/computers.lua: tick it to add it
auto.computer_hint: Every prop ticked here is "%s" wherever the game has one.
auto.empty: No computer in configs/shared/computers.lua is a prop model.
auto.toast_on: Props in the world are computers
auto.toast_off: Props in the world are no longer computers

props.hint: Add any prop model the game has, streamed ones included. A computer can then be placed as it, one can be picked from the world, and the Automatic tab offers it to every automatic computer. Then draw its screen, from its tile in the Props tab.
props.tab_hint: Every prop a computer can be: placed as, picked from the world as, or ticked in the Automatic tab. The ones from configs/shared/admin.lua are changed in that file; the ones added here can be removed here.
props.taken: That prop is already on the list.
props.label: Name
props.screen_hint: A prop of your own has no screen until you draw one: Draw screen, under it in the Props tab. Until then it is still a computer, opening fullscreen.
props.screen_none_hint: It has no screen yet, so it opens fullscreen and shows nothing in the world. Draw where its screen is.
props.screen_adjust_hint: Redraw where the screen is on this prop
props.screen_reset: Take the drawn screen away: back to the built-in one, if it has one

about.modern: A current desktop: centred taskbar, Start menu, rounded translucent windows.
about.retro: A 1991 shell inside a CRT monitor: grey bevelled windows, a DOS boot, period sounds.
about.mac: Top menu bar, a magnifying dock and windows with traffic-light buttons.

cameras.name: Name
cameras.area_hint: The heading the Security Cameras app lists it under. Cameras with the same heading are listed together; leave it empty for none.
cameras.access_anyone: Anyone the app is offered to
cameras.jobs_empty: No jobs listed: anyone sitting at a computer can watch it.
cameras.jobs_hint: Add a job (or gang) as your framework spells it, and the lowest grade allowed. Only they are offered the camera, and the server checks it.
cameras.fly_hint: Next you fly the camera to where it hangs. What you see is what it will show, and Enter keeps it.
cameras.search: Search by name, heading, id or job
cameras.none_placed: No camera put up from the panel yet.
cameras.watched_by_anyone: Anyone at a computer can watch it
cameras.delete_confirm: "%s" is taken down for good. Anyone watching it right now keeps its picture until they leave it.
cameras.remove_config_confirm: "%s" is no longer offered to anyone. It comes from the config, so it stays in this list and you can restore it at any time.
cameras.removed_hint: Removed in this panel: nobody is offered it until it is restored
cameras.full: No more than %s cameras can be put up from the panel
cameras.disabled: The Security Cameras app is switched off for the whole server (Enabled in configs/shared/cameras.lua), so nobody is offered any of these.

printers.place_hint: Next you stand it with the gizmo: on a desk, a counter or the floor.
printers.pick_title: Make an existing prop a printer
printers.pick_hint: Aim at a printer or copier the game already has in the world and press Enter. Nothing is spawned: the prop standing there becomes this printer.
printers.picked_hint: A prop the game already has in the world, so it cannot be swapped or moved. Delete this printer to give the prop back.
printers.name: Name
printers.name_hint: What the Print dialog calls it, so people know which one to walk to.
printers.no_props: No printer props are listed in configs/shared/printers.lua.
printers.empty: No printers yet. Place one near a computer and its apps can print to it.
printers.about: A computer prints to the printers within %s m of it. The pages wait in the tray until somebody takes them, as the %s item.
printers.disabled: Printing is switched off for the whole server (Enabled in configs/shared/printers.lua).
printers.full: There are as many printers as the panel can make (%s).
printers.delete_confirm_tray: "%s" is removed for good, and the %s pages waiting in its tray go with it.
printers.item_missing: Your inventory has no "%s" item yet, so nobody can take a page from a tray. Add it (README > Printers) and restart the inventory.

camtool.title: Put up a camera
camtool.hint: What you see is what the camera will show.

hint.draw: Drag across the glass, from one corner to the opposite one.
hint.fit: Drag an edge or a corner to fit it. Scroll in until the glass starts to hide the picture, then back out a notch. V checks it from the side.
hint.side: Scroll until the picture sits on the glass, and lean it (Q / E) until it lies flat on it. F goes back to the front.
hint.edge: Too far round to drag from here: F faces the screen again.
hint.looking: Looking around. Let go to get the cursor back.

notes.snapped: On the prop's surface. Scroll in until the glass starts to hide the picture, then back out a notch
notes.no_surface: Nothing to sit it on there: use the wheel
notes.copied: Copied: paste it into Models in configs/shared/screens.lua

common.view_only_hint: You can look around, but changes need the edit permission.

pick.title: Pick a prop
pick.none: Aim at a monitor or laptop
pick.none_printer: Aim at a printer or copier

warnings.floating: Floating %s m above the ground — press Alt to drop it
